leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the eighteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest Collections were released by in 2015 and 2016, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

===Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on November 4, 2015 and in New Zealand on November 18, 2015. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6410.

====Contents====
 

===Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on March 2, 2016 and in New Zealand on March 23, 2016. It contains three discs with 23 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6411. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

====Contents====
 

==Season 18 disc set==
 
The Season 18 DigiPack disc set, also referred to as Pokémon: XY Kalos Quest Complete Collection in promotional material, was released by in Australia on June 1, 2016 and in New Zealand on June 15, 2016. It contains six discs with 45 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7204.
 

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest episodes.
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection

==Trivia==
 
Prior to its release, Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest - Collection 1 used a different cover that did not include and had a blue background rather than red.
